instruction: The poster_party_night.webp file was accidentally sent to the Trash. Please restore it back to where it was.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: [ -f /home/user/Desktop/poster_party_night.webp ] && echo 'File exists.' || echo 'File does not exist.'

metadata.explanation: File recovery task with emphasis on restoring to original location (Desktop). Evaluator confirms file presence using shell test command.
